description: Read the alerts this account has sent, across email, Telegram, webhook and the web interface, with the delivery outcome of each. Use it to answer "was I actually told about this outage" and to find a channel that is silently failing - a monitor can be detecting downtime correctly while its webhook has been rejecting every delivery. Covers the whole account, not one monitor.

channel.description: Return only alerts sent through this channel. Omit for all channels.

status.description: Return only alerts with this delivery status.

name: get_notifications
